command:
set -e
pnpm typecheck
node --import tsx scripts/build.ts
pnpm test
pnpm exec fallow --changed-since HEAD --fail-on-issues
pnpm exec eslint src/serialization/encode.ts src/serialization/parse.ts src/serialization/frames.ts src/serialization/facets/native.ts src/__tests__/serialization.spec.ts src/__tests__/sparse-codec.spec.ts scripts/check-serialization-lean.ts
pnpm exec ls-lint --config .ls-lint.yaml
pnpm exec vitest --no-watch --config vitest-library.config.ts src/__tests__/serialization.spec.ts src/__tests__/sparse-codec.spec.ts
lake build --wfail
node --harmony-temporal --import tsx scripts/check-lean.ts
node --harmony-temporal research/serialization/scalar-wire-review/check.mjs "$PWD/lib/neutral/index.js" A
